description: Curated benchmark genomic data processing pipelines for demonstration and validation

samples.name: Valid Full WGS Germline Pipeline
samples.description: End-to-end standard Whole Genome Sequencing pipeline: QC, trimming, BWA MEM alignment, SAM/BAM conversion, coordinate sorting, BAM indexing, and GATK HaplotypeCaller variant discovery.
samples.pipeline_text:
FASTQC --in sample_raw.fastq --out qc_report.html
TRIMMOMATIC --in sample_raw.fastq --out sample_trimmed.fq --minlen 36 --slidingwindow 4:20
BWA MEM --ref reference.fa --in sample_trimmed.fq --out sample_aligned.sam --threads 8
SAMTOOLS VIEW --in sample_aligned.sam --out sample_aligned.bam --threads 4
SAMTOOLS SORT --in sample_aligned.bam --out sample_sorted.bam --threads 4
SAMTOOLS INDEX --in sample_sorted.bam
GATK HaplotypeCaller --ref reference.fa --in sample_sorted.bam --out raw_variants.vcf

samples.name: Valid Alignment and Indexing Pipeline
samples.description: Streamlined alignment and sorting pipeline without variant calling.
samples.pipeline_text:
FASTQC --in reads.fastq --out qc_report.html
BWA MEM --ref hg38.fa --in reads.fastq --out aligned.sam
SAMTOOLS SORT --in aligned.sam --out aligned_sorted.bam
SAMTOOLS INDEX --in aligned_sorted.bam

samples.name: Invalid Pipeline: Unknown Command and Malformed Parameters
samples.description: Uses unsupported tool BOWTIE2 and invalid integer values for threads.
samples.pipeline_text:
BOWTIE2 --in sample.fastq --out aligned.sam
TRIMMOMATIC --in sample.fastq --out sample_trimmed.fq --slidingwindow invalid_format --threads -2
SAMTOOLS VIEW --in aligned.sam --out aligned.bam

samples.name: Invalid Pipeline: Omitted Mandatory Parameters
samples.description: BWA MEM called without --ref or --out, and GATK called without --ref.
samples.pipeline_text:
FASTQC --in raw_sample.fastq
BWA MEM --in raw_sample.fastq
SAMTOOLS SORT --in sample.bam
GATK HaplotypeCaller --in sample.bam --out variants.vcf

samples.name: Invalid Pipeline: Inverted Workflow Sequence
samples.description: Attempts variant calling before alignment, and read trimming after variant calling.
samples.pipeline_text:
GATK HaplotypeCaller --ref ref.fa --in sample_sorted.bam --out variants.vcf
BWA MEM --ref ref.fa --in sample.fq --out sample.sam
TRIMMOMATIC --in sample.fq --out sample_trimmed.fq --minlen 36

samples.name: Invalid Pipeline: Undefined Input Files and In-Place Overwrite
samples.description: References non-existent intermediate files and overwrites input with output file.
samples.pipeline_text:
SAMTOOLS VIEW --in non_existent_reads.sam --out converted.bam
SAMTOOLS SORT --in converted.bam --out converted.bam
GATK HaplotypeCaller --ref ref.fa --in missing_final.bam --out variants.vcf

samples.name: Invalid Pipeline: Unindexed BAM Input for GATK
samples.description: Attempts GATK HaplotypeCaller without indexing the BAM with SAMTOOLS INDEX first.
samples.pipeline_text:
FASTQC --in reads.fastq --out qc.html
BWA MEM --ref ref.fa --in reads.fastq --out reads.sam
SAMTOOLS SORT --in reads.sam --out reads_sorted.bam
GATK HaplotypeCaller --ref ref.fa --in reads_sorted.bam --out out.vcf
